capabilities: Suggest a destination folder for each inbox note and file it after confirmation
Suggest internal links for mentions of existing notes while typing
Batch-organize inbox notes from the status bar or file explorer context menus
Route suggestions through hosted providers (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible) or a local Ollama model
Cap and track daily AI requests per device
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; one inbox folder only; filing and linking share a daily request cap (default 100) tracked locally; suggestions may be wrong and moves that would break links are refused; undo lasts until Obsidian restarts.
problem: Unsorted inbox notes pile up and mentions of existing notes go unlinked, and Obsidian offers no guided way to file or link them in the editor.

relations.evidence: right-click notes in the file explorer or Notebook Navigator
Ollama: enter the base URL and an installed model ID
OpenRouter: link an OpenRouter API key and enter a full model ID

requires.name: : hosted providers need an API key
: a local Ollama model or OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: AI-assisted organizer that suggests a folder for inbox notes and internal links for mentions, applying nothing until you confirm.
